name: booking-faq
description: Write booking FAQs and appointment booking replies from your approved terms: explain the booking process, draft booking messages and check existing booking text against your cancellation policy and deposit terms. Use when you ask “write our booking FAQ”, “reply to this booking question” or “check our cancellation answers.” For local service owners. Provide customer questions with unnecessary personal details removed and approved terms for each branch. Keeps deposit and cancellation exceptions and separates booking inquiries, provisional holds and confirmed appointments. Uses only supplied text and files. Not for calendar access, checking availability, making reservations, sending messages or fetching links.
